raw_tcp_payload: Count every selected TCP payload byte per flow before SYN/handshake/reassembly branches; include SYN/TFO bytes, retransmissions and grace; malformed/truncated packets remain global UNKNOWN.
zero_payload_setup: Captured initial SYN and zero raw TCP payload: missing SYNACK is setup-incomplete/noTLS evidence abstention, not inferred capture loss or inferred connection-failure cause. All other errors remain strict.
primary_scope: Flow observed before primary end and not closed before primary start; grace-only attempts are not primary obligations.
zero_payload_setup_only: Explicit measurement start required; at least one initial SYN inside primary interval; every primary-scope flow has captured initial SYN and zero raw TCP payload. This permits null TLS anchor only; all other capture/clock/flow errors remain strict. No fake TLS anchor or classifier evidence.
denominator: Retain primary zero-payload flow identities in actual flow denominator; noTLS is unsupported evidence, not stealth.
ordering: Unchanged a285 semantics and masks; no tolerance, raw sorting or clamping.
